primary_variables.matched_definition: Comparison among progenitor, differentiated, induced, lineage-committed, or maturation states.
evidence: To systematically profile proteome dynamics during human embryonic stem cell differentiation into oligodendrocytes
we studied the global proteome signature of developing OL by conducting a stepwise differentiation process to differentiate the hESC RH6 line into an OL lineage.
This process provided us with cell samples from each of the distinct stages of OL differentiation: hESCs, NSCs, NPCs, pre-OPCs, OPCs, and OLs.

attributes.route_or_context: pre-OPCs' expansion and maturation toward OPCs
evidence: 10 ng/mL platelet-derived growth factor AA (PDGF-AA), 5 ng/mL hepatocyte growth factor, 10 ng/mL insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1), 10 ng/mL neurotrophin 3 (NTF3), 60 ng/mL 3,3,5-triiodo-l-thyronine (T3 [thyroid hormone]), 25 µg/mL insulin, 100ng/mL biotin, and 1 µM cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP), were added to the culture medium for 60 days

attributes.route_or_context: OPCs were differentiated into MBP+ OLs
evidence: OPCs were differentiated into MBP+ OLs in the presence of 10 mM 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)-1-piperazineethanesulfonic acid (HEPES) buffer and 20 µg/mL ascorbic acid (supportive for OL differentiation)

evidence: monitored changes in protein abundance using a multiplexed tandem mass tag-based proteomics approach
relative protein expression changes were quantified from the fragmentation of the tags
comparative pairwise analysis of differentiation stages demonstrated that abundances of 352 proteins differentially changed between consecutive differentiation time points.
